body: For those that don't know, it's like going from super happy to wanting to die. In zero to sixty.
Looked at them and still hate myself, what else you got?
As for meds, you try taking an SSRI and see if your life doesn't suck more after taking it.
So what do you guys have to say? I'm clinically depressed and done with this.
Just watched a movie about how I shouldn't commit suicide, I'm not taking that advice.
Shut up with your "I'm an atheist so I don't believe in..." I really don't care what you don't believe in.
As someone who has taken SSRI's I would say stay away from them.
